run_image_classification_pipeline: run an image classification pipeline using a pretrained ViT model on a single image URL
test_image_classification_batch: test the image classification pipeline with a batch of images including URLs and PIL images
test_float16_image_classification: test the image classification pipeline with torch float16 dtype for faster inference
test_multilabel_classification: test multi-label image classification by setting problem_type to multi_label_classification on the model config
test_sigmoid_function: test the image classification pipeline with sigmoid function applied instead of softmax
